rules.text: per claim per side: paired over seeds (treatment arm vs control, same side). OK = sign matches direction AND z in the direction >= 3 AND |rel| >= 5 %. A phase rate is null when the phase lasted < 60 s (late phase in short matches). Valid pairs < 200 on either side => unmeasurable (no fallback registered: a rate cannot be merged across phases without mixing phases where the override is off). Precedence: unmeasurable > reversed > guard_failed > confirmed > one_sided > insufficient.

power: Whole-match tight reached z 5.19 (blue) / 7.90 (red) on general joinGo starts (C7 definition). Phases are not thirds: in the C7 control (median match 1100 s) early and mid each cover about 44 % of match time and late about 12 %; only 238 of 400 control matches have a late phase >= 60 s. Rough per-phase z if the effect is uniform: blue about 3.4 for early and mid, about 1.8 for late; red late about 2.7. Expected before the run: groupEarly/groupMid may sit near the blue threshold; groupLate is expected to be underpowered (insufficient) or unmeasurable (< 200 valid pairs). Late pairs only include seeds where both arms reach a late phase >= 60 s, and the treatment may change match length (selection after treatment) — another reason a late result is weak evidence either way. The threshold is not lowered and no seeds are added without a new range and Owner approval.
